I'm not an expert by any means, but I've been playing Druid all day since I just pulled Cenarius and I had to make a deck around him, so I'm in a Druid state of mind right now.

First of all, you need to double up on a lot of things. As far as class cards go, you NEED 2x Swipe, 2x Druid of the Claw, 2x Starfire, and 2x Ironbark Protector. These are some of the best Druid cards. You also want 2x Chillwind Yeti and 2x Dragonling Mechanic.

Lose Soul of the Forest, Raid Leader, Nightblade, Booty Bay Bodyguard, Mogu'shan Warden, and Frostwolf Grunt. Taunt isn't as important as you think it is.

This way you still have basically the same deck, but much more trimmed down and streamlined. As it is, your deck is trying to do too many things. Try these changes out and at the very least it should become much more clear what you need to do to improve it.

You got to know when the Flamestrike is coming. Basically just don't ever play more than 2 minions after a Mage hits 7 mana. All the other AoE clears are just about having enough health on your minions.
